notes: Sides: ~4-5 px inside the thin rule beside the thick bar (on the right side the thin rule is the inner one too). The page is turned ~0.5 degree and the rules bow (left drifts ~20 px, right ~33 px, top ~23 px, bottom ~45 px from end to end), so points were set every ~300 px from the rule measured on full-resolution crops and pixel profiles; the bars are speckled, so profiles were taken over a few rows. Corners (README rule 2): the outline runs ~4-5 px inside the inner edge of the innermost (thin) arc, points every ~15-30 px, with a small step round each arc's end notch where it meets the side rule. Top-left corner: the Market St blocks run across the arcs (the thin arc is fused with block ink for most of its length); the arc's position there was taken from the white line between the thick and thin arcs, and the blocks are cut ~4 px inside the thin arc (rule 2: the part beyond the arc is outside). Along the top, the Market St blocks are fused to the thin rule; the edge goes through that block ink ~4 px below the rule, never through the rule. Holes (README rule 4): the rotated CITY & COUNTY ... ZONE MAP title, legend and scale block (lower right; rectangle on open bay paper), the compass rose with its three long arrows (outline kept between the PIER HEAD LINE lettering and the arrows, so that map line stays map), the SECTION 8 badge (bottom right; octagon clear of the arc), and 'Join Sec. 9' (inside the frame at lower left, next to Jackson Park; outline on paper, clear of the block ink). 'Join Sec. 1' prints above the top bar and 'Join Sec. 7' left of the left bar, so both are already outside. Kept as map: BAY OF SAN FRANCISCO, PIER HEAD LINE, FERRY BUILDING, street lettering, and the dotted box round Mission Rock (a real island, drawn with its zoning).
